resolved_findings: A FIFO configuration could block beyond the attempt budget before a deadline check. Regular-file descriptor admission and POSIX O_NONBLOCK now reject it before reading.
A successful output validation could be followed by a replacement that the terminal receipt hashed as COMPLETED. The actual validation-byte identities now have to match terminal inventory.

A SIGTERM-ignoring worker survived when its leader exited promptly. POSIX cleanup now always sends SIGKILL to the owned group after the leader wait. The dedicated Linux subreaper regression verifies and reaps signal termination without mistaking zombies for live workers.
